items.q: Protected well may be defined as
o: a dug shaft with a sealed apron and cover that keeps runoff and debris out
a bed covering impregnated with chemical that repels and kills mosquitoes
a pit latrine fitted with a vent pipe and fly screen to control smell and insects
the provision of facilities and services for the safe management of human excreta
items.s: Protected well: a dug shaft with a sealed apron and cover that keeps runoff and debris out. The other options describe Ventilated improved pit, Insecticide treated net, Sanitation.

items.s: Segregation at source: the separation of discard into categories where it is produced. The other options describe Free residual chlorine, Threshold limit value, Chlorine demand.

items.s: Insecticide treated net: a bed covering impregnated with chemical that repels and kills mosquitoes. The other options describe Pasteurisation, Danger zone, Foodborne illness.

the systematic examination of premises against hygiene requirements
items.s: Threshold limit value: the concentration in workplace air to which a worker may be exposed repeatedly without harm. The other options describe Occupational hazard, Food safety, Sanitary inspection.

items.q: Waste hierarchy may be defined as

items.s: Waste hierarchy: the ranking of options from avoiding rubbish first through recovery to safe final disposal. The other options describe Water closet, Public health nuisance, Sewerage.
